options.description: Only the intent records and other records are committed. The judge checks against your words on this machine; a clone elsewhere checks records against the intent records only. The judge's input and its tests are changed before landing, and the messages already committed stay in git history unless you ask to rewrite it.
options.label: Keep them out of git (Recommended)

options.description: Keeps today's behaviour: each message a record comes from goes into git, so any clone can check records against your words.
options.label: Commit the whole message

payload.question: Given that: should your messages stay out of git, with the judge reading them only from this machine's private log?
